profile_text.body:
Credo AI is a company founded in 2020 that sells an AI governance platform, described on its own site as a system for discovering AI, enforcing policies, proving compliance, and managing risk across models, agents, applications, and vendors. The company says it created the AI governance category and now applies the same approach to what it calls agent governance, with a registry for agents and agent-specific risk and controls. Its platform is built around a Knowledge Graph that combines regulatory intelligence with a customer's business context, and the company says it draws on more than 300 integrations and forward-deployed governance experts. Credo AI also offers GAIA, short for Govern AI Assistant, which it says is generally available in the platform.

The company's product is tracked as an AI governance and risk management platform, with policy packs covering the EU AI Act, the NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001. Credo AI states that these packs were written by a team that has worked within ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and the OECD. The site presents the platform as built from scratch for governance rather than added onto an existing GRC tool, and it cites Mastercard and IBM among the organizations it works with or has collaborated with, including IBM's Compliance Accelerators.

The company's own site frames AI as needing a trust layer comparable to security for cloud and governance for data, and says customers in insurance, financial services, federal, and healthcare are already using it. No litigation is recorded for Credo AI, and no MCP servers are listed.
